newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Third Palestinian dies in West Bank violence.
newsitem.headline: Third Palestinian dies in West Bank violence.

text.p: A Palestinian died in a Jerusalem hospital from wounds inflicted by Israeli troops during clashes, bringing to three the number of Palestinians killed in the West Bank on Tuesday, a spokesman said.
"He took a rubber bullet in his head," said Hadassah hospital spokesman Yossi Shoval.

Earlier on Tuesday a Jewish settler shot dead a 24-year-old Arab shopkeeper in the West Bank town of Hebron, touching off fierce clashes between troops and Palestinian stone-throwers in the divided town.

Israeli police said the settler and a companion opened fire from Uzi submachine guns after Palestinians sprayed teargas and hurled stones at them but Palestinian witnesses described the incident as an unprovoked attack.
Israeli troops fired rubber bullets to disperse hundreds of protesters in Hebron, wounding more than 100 Palestinians.

The violence underscored U.S. President Bill Clinton's failure to revive Middle East peacemaking during a White House meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who returned to Israel on Tuesday.
